hero.name: Ignacio Breñas Muñoz
hero.description: Specialized in TypeScript, Node.js, and Full-Stack ecosystems. Hands-on experience in client-server architectures, RESTful APIs, optimized databases, and virtualized infrastructure.

about.title: About Me
about.lead: Software Developer focused on TypeScript and DAW student based in Barcelona, Spain (available for Barcelona and surroundings / Hybrid & On-site).
about.bio1: I hold a solid technical foundation acquired through academic education (Higher National Degree in Web Application Development and VET in Microcomputer Systems & Networks at STUCOM Pelai) and real-world production environments.
about.bio2: My technical profile integrates full-stack web development centered on TypeScript and Node.js, robust API design, data management and analytics, and virtualized infrastructure deployments (Docker, LXC containers, WSL, and Linux environments).
about.bio3: I consider myself a proactive, problem-solving professional with strong adaptability, accustomed to Agile workflows and passionate about delivering high value to dynamic software projects.

soterguard.bullet1: Development, maintenance, and deployment of web applications and On-Premise solutions for clients under Agile methodologies.
soterguard.bullet2: Design and implementation of server logic and RESTful APIs utilizing Node.js, TypeScript, and Python.
soterguard.bullet3: Management, modeling, and optimization of relational databases (PostgreSQL) with PrismaORM.
soterguard.bullet4: Configuration and provisioning of virtualized environments using Docker, LXC containers, and WSL.

vimtech.bullet1: Hardware diagnosis, maintenance, and repair with high specialization in Apple devices (Mac, iPhone, iPad).
vimtech.bullet2: Installation and configuration of operating systems (macOS, Windows, Linux distributions).
vimtech.bullet3: Tailored customer technological advisory and incident troubleshooting.

ajma.bullet1: Design, administration, and continuous maintenance of the association's official website.
ajma.bullet2: Comprehensive IT workstation support and technical audiovisual assistance (camera and sound) at public events.

daw.degree: Higher National Diploma in Web Application Development (DAW)
daw.description: Advanced training in full-stack web engineering, modern frameworks (React, Angular, Symfony, Laravel), client-server paradigms, web security, and relational database modeling.

smr.description: Comprehensive foundation in local area network administration, Windows/Linux server management, virtualization, hardware assembly, technical support, and backup security protocols.
